description: This file defines the ShippingRateProvider interface used for obtaining shipping rate quotes within the shipping service module of the project. It specifies contract methods for provider identification and quote retrieval.

classes.name: ShippingRateProvider
classes.description: Interface for shipping rate quote providers, requiring implementation of providerCode and quote methods.

methods.name: providerCode
methods.description: Returns a stable identifier for the shipping provider.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Returns a list of RateQuote objects for a given request, or an empty list if unsupported.
